cases.summary: Agent opens Client Registration and selects an available MSISDN
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation; available MSISDN stock on staging
cases.input: 1. Open Client Registration. 2. Select one available MSISDN.
cases.expected: An available MSISDN is selected and the flow continues to customer details.

cases.summary: KYC form captures the named customer fields
cases.preconditions: On customer details after MSISDN select
cases.input: 1. Observe First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Address, Nationality, ID Type, ID Number, Alternate Number.
cases.expected: Those fields are present. Other mandatory KYC fields are not named (Q-001) and are not invented.
cases.traceability: SAA-910; REQ-002; Step 2: Enter Customer Details

cases.summary: Registration allowed when customer has fewer than 3 active SIMs
cases.preconditions: Customer ID with 2 active SIMs (boundary below threshold)
cases.input: 1. Complete details for that customer and proceed past SIM check.
cases.expected: Registration is allowed.

cases.summary: Three or more SIMs show a threshold message and SIM Swap shortcut
cases.input: 1. Proceed to SIM threshold check.
cases.expected: A SIM threshold exceeded message is shown. Registration stops. A shortcut to SIM Swap is offered. Exact wording is not quoted (Q-002).

cases.summary: Incomplete application cannot be submitted
cases.preconditions: On a registration step with a mandatory field empty
cases.input: 1. Leave a mandatory field empty. 2. Attempt to continue or submit. 3. Attempt to skip a step.
cases.expected: Mandatory fields cannot be empty. Required documents and images are required. No step can be skipped. Incomplete application cannot be submitted.

cases.summary: Senegalese ID Card requires front, back, and customer photo
cases.preconditions: Personal registration; Senegalese ID Card selected; MFS not selected
cases.input: 1. Attempt to continue without each of ID Front, ID Back, Customer Photo in turn.
cases.expected: Each of ID Front, ID Back, and Customer Photo is required. Contract is not required.
cases.traceability: SAA-910; REQ-006, REQ-012; Attachment Rules — Senegalese ID Card

cases.summary: Passport requires passport image and customer photo
cases.preconditions: Personal registration; Passport selected; MFS not selected
cases.input: 1. Attempt to continue without Passport Image, then without Customer Photo.
cases.expected: Passport Image and Customer Photo are required.

cases.summary: CEDEAO Card requires front, back, and customer photo
cases.input: 1. Attempt to continue without Front, Back, or Customer Photo.
cases.expected: Front, Back, and Customer Photo are required.

cases.summary: Refugee Card requires front, back, and customer photo
cases.input: 1. Attempt to continue without Front, Back, or Customer Photo.
cases.expected: Front, Back, and Customer Photo are required.

cases.summary: Procuration registration requires the procuration document
cases.input: 1. Attempt to continue without the procuration document. 2. Upload it and submit.
cases.expected: Procuration document is required. Request sends IsProcuration = 1 (backend evidence, not a UI assertion).

cases.summary: MFS selected makes signature contract mandatory
cases.input: 1. Attempt to continue without the contract image.
cases.expected: Customer signature contract is mandatory and the contract image must be uploaded.

cases.summary: MFS not selected does not require a contract
cases.input: 1. Complete registration without uploading a contract.
cases.expected: Contract image is not required and should not be uploaded.
cases.traceability: SAA-910; REQ-012; MFS Wallet Not Selected

cases.summary: Auto certification payload is not stated
cases.preconditions: Customer already has at least one SIM and KYC is unchanged
cases.input: 1. Submit registration.
cases.expected: Cannot be expected-resulted. The ticket's Send line is blank.

cases.summary: Uploaded file names follow the stated pattern
cases.preconditions: Successful document upload; access to stored files
cases.input: 1. Upload required documents. 2. Inspect stored file names.
cases.expected: Names match 1_<SubscriberMSISDN>_<AgentMSISDN>_<Timestamp>_<DocumentType>.jpg with the document types listed in the ticket.

cases.summary: Successful registration receipt shows Transaction ID and Certification Status
cases.input: 1. Observe the receipt.
cases.expected: Receipt displays Transaction ID and Certification Status. Allowed status values are not listed.

cases.summary: Receipt can be downloaded, shared, and sent via device apps
cases.input: 1. Download. 2. Share. 3. Send via email or another device app.
cases.expected: Download, share, and send via email/apps supported by the device are available.

cases.summary: SIM threshold and country rules are configurable from Admin Portal
cases.input: 1. Locate SIM threshold and country-specific registration rules.
cases.expected: Not testable from the mobile app. No portal steps are in the ticket.

cases.summary: Senegalese passport is recorded as Senegalese Id Card with ID = MRZ Opt1
cases.input: 1. Scan a Senegalese passport.
cases.expected: Document is marked as Senegalese Id Card. Numéro de la pièce d'identité = MRZ Opt1.
cases.traceability: SAA-910; REQ-018; MVP CR changes — SENEGAL passport

cases.summary: Non-Senegalese passport is recorded as passport with ID = passportNumber
cases.input: 1. Scan a non-Senegalese passport.
cases.expected: Document is marked as passport. ID number = passportNumber.
cases.traceability: SAA-910; REQ-019; MVP CR changes — Else branch

cases.summary: Senegalese ID card makes address mandatory and read-only
cases.input: 1. Observe the address field.
cases.expected: Address is mandatory and read-only. Literal value Address vs card address is Q-006; assert mandatory + read-only only.

cases.summary: CEDEAO card makes address mandatory and editable
cases.preconditions: isoAlpha2CountryCode in BJ, GN, GW, GM, SL, NG, ML
cases.input: 1. Observe and edit the address field.
cases.expected: Address is mandatory and the agent can fill it.

cases.summary: Passport makes address mandatory and editable
cases.input: 1. Observe and edit the address field.
cases.expected: Address is mandatory and editable.

cases.summary: ID card MRZ mismatch on name or date of birth stops the flow
cases.preconditions: Senegalese ID or CEDEAO where first name, last name, or DOB disagrees with MRZ
cases.input: 1. Scan the ID. 2. Present a mismatch on SecondaryId, PrimaryId, or DateOfBirth.
cases.expected: Flow stops. Message text is not quoted (Q-005).
cases.traceability: SAA-910; REQ-023; MRZ comparison, ID branches

cases.summary: Passport MRZ mismatch including DocumentNumber stops the flow
cases.preconditions: Senegal or foreign passport with a DocumentNumber mismatch
cases.input: 1. Scan the passport with DocumentNumber disagreeing with MRZ DocumentNumber.
cases.expected: Flow stops. Message text is not quoted.
cases.traceability: SAA-910; REQ-024; MRZ comparison, passport branches
